title: K-13
desc: After finding a dead girl with whom he spent the night, an aspiring moviemaker attempts to recollect his memories while planning to flee in order to avoid chaos.

title: Kalaba Kadhalan
desc: Akhilan is pursued by his sister-in-law, Kanmani, and decides to get her married to a family member, to dodge her. But his actions bear severe consequences, when the family finds Kanmani dead.

title: Maanagara Kaaval
desc: ACP Subhash must race against the clock to protect the prime minister of India and figure out whose plan it is to secretly eliminate her.

title: Tughlaq Durbar
desc: A young politician has devious plans to advance his career. However, he suddenly develops a conscientious alter ego that interferes with his crooked efforts.

title: Namma Veettu Pillai
desc: Arumpon is a village youth who adores his adopted sister and constantly dotes on her. However, he gets forced to fix her marriage to a ruffian he despises.
